summary: Live alias swap routed mixed-dimension embeddings -> suppressed top-k and rerank tail latency
description:
Issue summary:
During a scheduled alias swap for BrightCart's embedding endpoint (alias 'products-search-v2'), a subset of live requests were routed to a historical variant with a different embedding dimensionality (768 vs 1024). The reranker began returning fewer candidates and observed suppressed top-k results for approximately 18 minutes. Customers reported degraded search recall and intermittent tail latency spikes on the rerank endpoint.

Impact:
- BrightCart production search traffic experienced reduced recall (missing expected top-5 results).
- Several calls to /rerank returned truncated candidate lists or empty results triggering client-side fallbacks.
- Tail latency for rerank increased from baseline ~120ms to ~900-1400ms for affected requests while fallback re-embedding paths activated.

Why this is surprising:
Routing logic is expected to keep alias-to-model variant mapping consistent across the traffic plane. The swap should have been atomic; mixed-dimension embeddings should be prevented by preflight checks.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Create two embedding model versions with different dims: open-embed-v1-768 and open-embed-v2-1024.
2) Configure alias 'products-search-v2' pointing to v1, warm the cache with index data and cached embeddings.
3) Trigger alias swap to v2 via Console rollouts (canary=0.0->1.0) while leaving embedding cache TTL active.
4) Observe that some incoming requests still hit replicas serving v1 embeddings while downstream reranker expects v2 dims, causing candidate suppression and fallback re-embeds.
logs: 2026-03-12T15:03:21Z router INFO Route assigned alias products-search-v2 -> open-embed-v2-1024
2026-03-12T15:03:23Z embed-cache WARN key=product-124 miss dim=768 expected=1024
2026-03-12T15:03:23Z reranker ERROR topk_truncate detected input_dims=768 expected_dims=1024 returned_k=3
2026-03-12T15:21:05Z api-gateway WARN downstream fallback triggered: client=brightcart-search service=rerank reason=empty-topk
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: atomic alias swap partially applied across routing plane leading to mixed-model routing.
Observed embed-cache entries were not invalidated during rollout; TTL and sticky-cache keys allowed v1 embeddings to persist.
Router metrics show ~12% of requests for 18 minutes routed to replicas still running v1 binary while alias metadata pointed to v2 in control plane.
We confirmed the reranker enforces an input dimension check and will drop candidates with mismatched dims rather than auto-resize; this prevented silent corruption but reduced recall.
No code rollback occurred; rollout finished but stale ephemerally-cached routing entries in certain edge proxies persisted until connection churn.
Reproduction in staging achieved by toggling alias with low connection churn and short TTLs; replication consistent with production incident.
comments: Ava Martinez (Support): Customer reports missing results and tail latency - collecting logs and reproducer. (2026-03-12)
Jordan Lin (SRE): Noted mismatch in embed dims in logs; raising router/alias atomicity hypothesis. Investigating sticky proxies and cache TTL handling. (2026-03-12)
Priya Rao (Platform Eng): Found that older replicas did not pick up new alias mapping until health-check cycle at ~18 minutes. Filed INT-997 to track router refresh behavior. (2026-03-13)
BrightCart (Customer): We saw search relevance drop for ~20 minutes coincident with your deployment window. We had to disable auto-rollout temporarily. (2026-03-13)

Jordan Lin (SRE): Implemented emergency mitigation: forced proxy reconnects for BrightCart nodes and purged embed-cache keys with schema mismatch. Observed recall restore and latency return to baseline. (2026-03-13)
Support (Ava): Customer confirmed restoration; monitoring for reoccurence and planning follow-up. (2026-03-14)
resolution_notes:
Applied three-pronged mitigation: 1) purged embed-cache entries for affected namespace to avoid stale-dim reuse, 2) forced control-plane refresh on edge proxies so alias mapping became consistent across routing plane, 3) added a soft-guard in the reranker to return informative error instead of silent truncation when dims mismatch (hotfix PR linked).

Follow-ups scheduled: create a preflight check in rollouts to validate dim compatibility and enforce cache invalidation on alias swaps; update alias swap runbook to include explicit proxy refresh step and add metrics alerting on dim-mismatch rate >0.1%. See INT-997 for router refresh fix.
postmortem_action_items: 1) Implement atomic alias swap verification across control and data plane (owner: Platform Eng, ETA 2026-04-02).
2) Ensure embed-cache invalidation step as part of alias rollout flow (owner: Runtime Team, ETA 2026-03-28).
3) Add an alert for embedding-dim-mismatch ratio and topk-truncate counts (owner: SRE, ETA 2026-03-20).
4) Update Console rollout UI to warn when target model dim != source model dim (owner: Console Product, ETA 2026-04-09).
